entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to process a return for a VeloBand. Just email me the shipping label.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I get you to the right place, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Look, it's not broken. I just don't want it. I tried to do this online last week but your website wasn't working. I'm busy, so let's just get this done.
I understand completely. Let me pull up your account to get this sorted out. Can I get your order number, please?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 17th. That puts you at day 15, which is just outside our strict 10-day return policy for this specific device.

I just told you, I tried to return it last week, which was inside your window. Your system was down. I couldn't get the form to load, and I certainly couldn't print a label. It was a complete website error on your end, not mine.

I appreciate you clarifying that. Let me check our technical logs for last week... You're absolutely right. I can see a documented note that our return portal had a major system down event on December 26th. Is that around the time you were trying to access it?
Yes, that was the day. I was getting frustrated and even took a screenshot of the error message before I gave up. It was a waste of my time.

That screenshot won't be necessary; this note is all the verification I need. I sincerely apologize. You should never be penalized for our technical issues. Since you attempted the return within the policy window and were blocked by our system, I am overriding the date lock and approving a full refund for you.
Okay. So the label is coming?

Yes. It's already in your inbox. And for the trouble our website error caused you, and as you're one of our VIP customers, I've also gone ahead and added a $100 goodwill credit to your VeloFit account. You can use that on any future purchase.
A hundred dollars? Okay, that's actually very helpful. I appreciate that. Thank you, Diana.
You are very welcome. We value your business. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
